item.title: Beyblade X 'True Future' Arc Drops April 17: Double Episode Premiere Details
item.description: The Beyblade X anime officially launches its “True Future Arc” on Friday, April 17, 2026, kicking off with a double-episode premiere (Episodes 123 and 124) streaming at 7:00 PM JST on the official BEYBEY TUBE YouTube channel.
